question: Which of the following countries is the second largest steel producer in the world as per the World Steel Association (worldsteel) as of October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India is the second largest steel producer in the world as per the World Steel Association (worldsteel) as of October 2020.
 
• Asia produced 1,374.9 Mt of crude steel in 2020, an increase of 1.5% compared to 2019.
 
• China’s crude steel production in **2020 reached 1,053.0 Mt, up by 5.2% on 2019.**
 
• China’s share of global crude steel production increased from **53.3% in 2019 to 56.5% in 2020.**
 
• **India’s crude steel production for 2020 was 99.6 Mt, down by 10.6% on 2019.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Sajjan Jindal is the first representative from India to serve as Chairman of the World Steel Association.
 
• About World Steel Association (WSA):
 
 
• WSA acts as the focal point for the steel industry.
 
• It is providing global leadership on all major strategic issues impacting the industry.
 
• Its members represent approximately 85 per cent of the world's steel production.
 
• It was established in 1967 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
